_comment: The buff was a STATIC ability, which maps to no event and never ran at all, gated on PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL with card_type/card_class keys the condition does not read -- and the card says nothing about arsenals. It is an Aura: at the beginning of your ACTION PHASE (CR 4.3.1, later than the start phase) it destroys itself and buffs the NEXT Guardian attack action you play this turn. One-shot, so MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK plus GRANT_NEXT_ATTACK; as a static it would have buffed every Guardian attack for the rest of the turn.
